scope: Exact openKylin root-marker addition to the existing production read-only pose observer

original_source.license_status: Upstream does not declare a license for this source file; the full source remains an external local build input. This integration neither republishes nor relicenses it.

compiler_template.role: Compiler arguments only; measurement criteria stored in the diagnostic template do not replace pose-watch acceptance.

openvr_sdk.license: Original Valve BSD license retained alongside local build inputs; separate from the observer source license status.

preserved_behavior: All argv, library-path, identity and OpenVR property checks remain unchanged except the rootfs marker alternative.
The original refusal-message text remains unchanged.
Raw finite/connected/Running_OK pose sampling and stop-marker timing remain unchanged.
Success still requires accepted_before_stop > 0, nonfinite == 0, invalid_after_stop >= 100, valid_after_stop == 0 and no clock error.
No pose synthesis, recenter, settings, controller, chaperone, producer, driver or bounded_run modifications.
publication: Only this small integration patch, lock and build recipe belong in this repository; do not add the full observer source or push a third-party license replacement.

optional_display_guard.scope: Explicit private-session display guard; observation and raw validity acceptance remain unchanged
